marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southeast 15 knots early this evening
and to east 25 late overnight. Wind increasing to east 30 near noon
Friday. Scattered flurries ending this evening. Scattered flurries
Friday afternoon and evening. Temperatures minus 7 rising to minus 1
overnight. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 2 Friday
morning and to 3 Friday afternoon.<br/>
